title: Reusing Past Samples in Proximal Policy Optimization: When and How Does It Help?
abstract: arXiv:2610.01399v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Among on-policy deep reinforcement learning methods, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) has become the de facto standard, due to its consistently strong empirical performance across diverse application domains. However, on-policy methods are inherently sample inefficient: fresh data collected under the current policy is used for just a few updates before being discarded. Off-policy methods avoid this inefficiency via experience replay, achieving notable sample efficiency gains, but at the cost of training instabilities or extensive tuning. This motivated the rise of hybrid strategies that augment PPO with off-policy data reuse. Existing sample-reuse variants of PPO demonstrated improved sample efficiency over vanilla PPO, yet a systematic study of when reuse helps, in which scenarios, and to what extent remains missing. translated_title: 在近端策略优化中重用过去样本：何时以及如何有所帮助？
translated_abstract: 在在线策略深度强化学习方法中，近端策略优化（PPO）已成为事实上的标准，这得益于其在多种应用领域中持续强劲的实证表现。然而，在线策略方法本质上样本效率低下：在当前策略下采集的新鲜数据仅用于几次更新后就被丢弃。离线策略方法通过经验回放避免了这种低效，实现了显著的样本效率提升，但代价是训练不稳定或需要大量调参。这促使了将PPO与离线策略数据重用相结合的混合策略的兴起。现有的PPO样本重用变体确实展示了相对于原始PPO的样本效率提升，然而，对于样本重用何时有帮助、在哪些场景下有帮助以及帮助到何种程度，仍缺乏系统性的研究。在这项工作中，我们通过在多重重要性采样框架内实例化两个变体，研究了PPO中样本重用的有效性。
tldr: 该论文通过在多重重要性采样框架内实例化两个PPO样本重用变体，系统研究了在PPO中重用过去样本何时、在何种场景下以及多大程度上能提升样本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies when, in which scenarios, and to what extent reusing past samples helps improve the sample efficiency of PPO, by instantiating two sample-reuse variants within a multiple importance sampling framework.
